name: Guide Hall v7 exterior
review_note: Civic three-part mass with the approved anchor language; the P2-D pass adds a fieldstone chimney with clay pot, laid ridge caps and eaves soffits. Reads as the island hall from the apron; family palette held at 18 materials.
improve: Ridge caps barely register at gameplay distance (same tile colours); the north gable and wings still want bargeboard finials and a datestone; roof furniture beyond the lantern and chimney is thin.
